text: Farah's due 2 November 2026. Text her the day before her last shift to say good luck with everything, then leave her alone for a bit.
chloe bday sat. she's obsessed w bouldering atm, maybe chalk bag or a day pass?

Ahmed and Pooja are expecting again!! Second one, due March 2027. He said they're keeping the sex a surprise this time. Their eldest, Noor, is apparently desperate for a sister and has already picked out names, mostly Disney princesses. Pooja's been really sick again like last time, so maybe hold off on the congratulations dinner until she's feeling better.
So Victor's christening thing is off, the vicar's ill and they couldn't get anyone else. They'll rebook in the new year apparently.
Hiroshi mentioned his daughter Yuki starts nursery on Monday and he's dreading the drop off more than she is. Message him that evening to see how it went.
Bought the wrapping paper, still need tape and a card for Nadia.
Kofi is really into vinyl at the moment. Collects old highlife records, mostly Ghanaian stuff from the 70s. Good gift territory.
Noor's baby shower is 14 December 2026 at her sister's. I'm doing the cake, she wants lemon.
Ignacio - turns 40 next Friday. Wife (Adriana) planning surprise dinner, DON'T mention it to him. She said he'd love a decent pair of running headphones.

Okay voice note. Just got off the phone with Salma. Her mum had the hip op yesterday and it went fine but she's in a lot of pain, and Salma's driving up and down every day which is wearing her out. Should ring her at the weekend, not before, she said she's too knackered to talk. And she mentioned her son Bilal got into the under twelves squad, so congratulate him next time I see them.
Jin's been feeling pretty low since the move, says the new flat is damp and the landlord isn't answering.
Remember: Manon's interview Thursday 10am. Good luck text that morning, and ask how it went the day after.
Nikolai and Svetlana had their little girl!! Born Sunday night, 3.4kg, called Mila. Both doing well. Need to get a card and something small, maybe a muslin set.
caitlin - pregnant (12 wks), only told family + me. morning sickness horrendous. veggie, can't stand the smell of coffee at the moment.
Aurelio's leaving do is the 30th. I'm going, already said yes. He starts at the new firm the week after.
Note to self, Yetunde loves anything lavender. Candles, soap, the lot. Her birthday's in Feb.

Kieran said his brother Tadhg is getting married in Galway in June 2027, and Kieran's best man and absolutely terrified of the speech. He's never done public speaking. Their dad died a few years back so Kieran feels he has to say something about him too. I offered to read a draft. Should chase him for it sometime in the spring, well before the stag in May.
Dentist moved to the 4th. Car MOT the day after. Ugh.
Chantal's dog Biscuit went missing on Tuesday, found him Wednesday morning in a neighbour's shed. She's still shaken. Drop round with something the next day maybe.
Spoke to Isabel at pickup. Her twins' christening is Sunday 8 November 2026, and she asked if I'd be godparent?? Need to reply properly by Friday.
nasser bday 12 nov, into F1 and fancy coffee. Last year got him beans, so not that again

Ifeoma is 34 weeks now and says she's fine but her husband said she's barely sleeping. Her mum flies in from Lagos the week before the due date to help out. She's also still working from home until the end of the month, which seems mad to me. Her husband asked me quietly if I could pop round one afternoon next week and keep her company, he thinks she's lonelier than she lets on.
Mrs Popescu next door told me her granddaughter was born last week in Bucharest, she's flying out to meet her on the 3rd.
Varun's wedding anniversary is Saturday, ten years. He asked me to remind him the evening before to pick up the flowers because he always forgets. Text him Friday around 6.

Lunch with Nora. Talked mostly about her kitchen reno and the fact that her eldest is applying to uni. She's hoping for Edinburgh, finds out in spring. The reno is dragging on, builders have gone quiet and they've been without a proper kitchen since August, washing up in the bath. Nora's birthday is coming up on 28 November 2026, so maybe a restaurant voucher, she could do with a night off cooking on a camping stove.
Alessia mentioned she's started pottery classes on Wednesdays and is loving it. Wants her own wheel eventually. Note for Christmas.

Ivan's had a rough week. Got told on Monday his department is being restructured, has a meeting with HR next Thursday to find out if his role survives. Must check in with him afterwards, maybe take him for a pint. His wife's just gone back to work after maternity leave too, so the timing couldn't be worse. He said he's applied for a couple of things already just in case.
Ahmed's son's first birthday party is a week on Sunday, at the soft play place. Bring something for the little one, he likes anything that makes noise according to Pooja.
Victor said Chloe's mum is coming over from Lyon for the christening when they rebook it. They're thinking late January.
Hiroshi (Hiro to everyone) is doing the Valencia marathon on 6 December 2026. First one. Says he's not nervous but he keeps bringing it up.
Flat viewing at 11, then the bank at 2. Get milk.

Farah texted. Baby came early!! Little boy, Zayn, born this morning at 5am. She's exhausted but fine. Send flowers once they're home, she said probably Thursday. Her mum's staying with them for the first fortnight. Apparently Zayn has a full head of black hair already, Farah sent a photo. I'll go and visit the week after once things have calmed down a bit.
farah also said her hubby's taking 2 wks off, back at work the 23rd
Remind me to ask Kofi how his sister's scan went. It was last Tuesday and I completely forgot to message.
Svetlana's mum is staying for the first month to help with Mila. Svetlana said it's lovely but also a lot, they're quite different about how to do things.
Jin - big Arsenal fan, hates Spurs with a passion, coeliac. Don't bring cake to his.
Salma's birthday is on Halloween, she hates it because everyone forgets. Get her something on the 30th so it arrives in time. She's into fountain pens.
Manon got the job!!! Starts 1 December. Celebratory drinks next Friday, she's booked the back room at the Fox.
Need to sort Noor's present before the shower, she put a list on the John Lewis site. Order by the 7th at the latest.

Just had a long call with Caitlin. The 20 week scan is on the 18th and she's anxious because last time they had a scare. Her partner Kieran can't get off work so her sister's going with her. I said I'd text the night before and then ring that evening to see how it went. She also asked whether I still had the moses basket, which I think is in the loft, so dig that out this weekend.
Uncle Nasser's 70th is in March 2027. Family's doing a big lunch, Adriana's coordinating. Everyone's chipping in for a watch.
Bilal starts his apprenticeship at the garage on Monday. Salma's proud but worried he'll hate the early starts.
Pooja says Ahmed's been on night shifts all month and is wiped. They've booked a week in Lanzarote in January to recover.
Isabel's partner Tadhg Costa had his knee op this morning. Went well. He's off his feet for six weeks, she's going to be run ragged with the twins.
birthday list for this month: Chloe (sat), Nasser (12th), and Kieran's lad turning 5 on the 27th, he's into dinosaurs and diggers.
Yetunde's daughter Ife is doing her grade 5 piano exam on the 25th. Yetunde's a bundle of nerves, Ife's totally calm. Ask how it went the following week.
Didn't get much out of Nikolai, he's running on two hours' sleep. Mila's got reflux. Drop off a lasagne Thursday.
Chantal's been dropping hints about a new pair of walking boots. Her birthday is 19 November 2026.

Aurelio and his wife have just found out they're having twins! Due in May 2027. He's thrilled and slightly panicking. Says the car won't fit two car seats. They've got a scan on the 12th to check everything's okay because twins are higher risk, and his wife Chantal is already being signed off from her teaching job early. Message him the day after the scan.
Varun said his grandmother passed away on Friday. Funeral is in Leicester on the 2nd. He seemed okay but quiet. I should send a card before then and check in on him the week after.
Sorted the venue for my own birthday drinks. Going with the rooftop place on the 15th.
Ignacio's dinner was a hit apparently, he cried. Adriana sent photos.
Ivan's partner Nora is training to be a midwife, final year. She works crazy hours.
Note: Svetlana and Nikolai want me at Mila's christening in spring. Confirm the date with them once they've spoken to the church.
Jin's mum is having cataract surgery on 9 November 2026. He's taking her and staying over the day after. Ring him that evening.

Long chat with Alessia at the school gate. Her brother Nasser is moving to Toronto in January with his family and she's gutted, they're really close. She's planning a farewell meal for the week before he goes and wants me to come. Also she's got a big presentation at work on Monday that she's been stressing over. Text her good luck Sunday night.
Manon's nickname for her baby bump is 'the bean'. Due date is 21 April 2027, she told me before her work knew.
kofi + yetunde 5th wedding anniv on the 14th. thinking a nice bottle, they both like a good malbec
Book the car in, renew passport, cancel the gym. Sunday.
Chloe's party got cancelled, she's got flu. Says she'll do something the following weekend instead if she's better. Maybe drop round with soup tomorrow.
